sentence: This project provides imaging and surgical services that let other projects study macrophage behavior and blood flow in the meninges of the brain.
This project builds a chip that copies the optic nerve head to study how astrocytes contribute to glaucoma.
This project uses machine learning on sleep recordings of brain activity to detect pathological aging and early Alzheimer's disease.
This project uses a dedicated breast positron emission tomography scanner to study breast cancer and how it responds to therapy.
This project studies how cancer-associated changes in a protein that organizes chromatin affect chromatin looping and gene expression.
This project studies how glioma cells fuse together and form tunneling membrane nanotubes to pass genes between cells.
This project studies how a signaling molecule affects lymphatic vessel growth in the heart during myocardial ischemia.
This project tries to find out which molecular programs let blood vessel and nerve networks talk to each other and to the developing kidney.
This project studies how early life adversity affects adolescent drug use vulnerability and whether neuromarkers can improve addiction risk assessment.
This project tries to find genes linked to the cilium that cause birth defects, using mouse models built to match patients with rare disorders.
This project studies how a gene found in genome-wide association studies changes type 2 alveolar epithelial cells and leads to pulmonary fibrosis.
This project builds deep learning methods to find gene-environment interactions that affect cancer prognosis in lung and skin cancers.
This project builds experimental and machine learning methods to study how circuits in the retina support visual perception.
This project studies how a hypothalamic pathway leads antipsychotic drugs to cause weight gain and obesity.
This project tests an imaging probe that responds to oxidative imbalance in mitochondria in mouse models of Alzheimer's disease and Huntington's disease.
This project tries to find the cellular and molecular drivers of disease progression in limbic-predominant age-related encephalopathy.
This project builds and adapts practical suicide prevention programs for youth and young adults so they can be delivered reliably at scale.
This project studies how a communication pathway in prostate cancer cells works and whether a drug that blocks it can kill those cells.
This project tests a therapy that enters the brain and clears the toxic polyglucosan bodies that cause Lafora disease.
This project studies how cigarette smoking causes heart dysfunction in veterans with hypertension through weakened cardioprotective signaling.
